text.p: SBS Technologies Inc said Tuesday it elected its chief executive, Christopher Amenson, to the additional post of chairman of the board.
The company said it appointed Stephen Cooper as president and chief operating officer, following a four-month search.
The company also said Andrew Cruce, a founder of the company, announced his resignation from the board.
Cruse, also the former chairman and CEO, will remain with the company as a consultant, SBS said.
Amenson is also the former president and chief operating officer.
Cooper most recently served as president and chief operating officer of I-Bus Inc, a San Diego-based maker of passive backplanes and customized enclosures, SBS said.
SBS Technologies is a manufacturer of standard bus embedded computer components that perform a broad range of central processing unit, general purpose input/output and special purpose functions.
